query:
WITH active AS (
 SELECT s.desired_scoring_version, g.result_json::jsonb AS result, v.rules_json::jsonb AS rules
 FROM service_state s JOIN evaluation_generations g ON g.id=s.active_generation_id
 JOIN scoring_versions v ON v.id=s.desired_scoring_version
 WHERE s.id=1 AND s.source_revision=g.source_revision AND s.desired_scoring_version=g.scoring_version
), scores AS (SELECT jsonb_array_elements(result->'gameScores') AS score FROM active)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'registeredMatches',(SELECT count(*) FROM matches WHERE state='registered'),
 'scoredMatches',(SELECT count(DISTINCT score->>'matchKey') FROM scores),
 'participantScores',(SELECT count(*) FROM scores),
 'algorithm',(SELECT rules->>'algorithmVersion' FROM active),
 'scoringVersion',(SELECT desired_scoring_version FROM active),
 'mismatchedVersions',(SELECT count(*) FROM scores,active WHERE score->>'scoringVersion'<>desired_scoring_version),
 'missingMatches',(SELECT count(*) FROM matches m WHERE m.state='registered' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM scores WHERE score->>'matchKey'=m.id)),
 'excludedMatchesScored',(SELECT count(*) FROM matches m WHERE m.state<>'registered' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM scores WHERE score->>'matchKey'=m.id))
);
